title: UploadIt
tagline: Dashboard that helps store and retrieve data from Filecoin via Lighthouse
description: This project uses the lighthouse SDK to help everyone even people with no technical knowledge to store and retrieve their data from Filecoin using the lighthouse SDK. This is a great project to help normal users have access to decentralized storage with just a few clicks. This type of application will bring better UX and mass adoption
how_its_made: This project uses @Lighthouse to store and retrieve all the data. We decided to make it a web app so that it becomes accessible to all users from any device that supports a wallet connection. That way any user can upload any data from any device in the world and retrieve their data whenever they want
